scope: Conservative same-target approach ACK-span overlap, using actual interleaved movement receipts and no inferred complete candidate/witness state.
correctionToV1Summary: summary-v1 closeChasePairCount was a bounded64 sample length, not an exhaustive total. This derived document computes the exact pair total from the complete selected actions without rereading raw.
limitations: An approach span is the interval between its first and last actually correlated successful chase ACK. Non-chat unrelated actions conservatively break it. It does not claim knowledge of every internal selection between receipts.

Owner-position distances compare actual receipts no more than1000ms apart, not a simultaneous authoritative world snapshot or exact target distance. Target position at chase decision is not persisted.
Shared IDs and overlapping observed effort establish duplicated pursuit effort; they do not prove that reservation alone would satisfy the18/12 window workload or remove all supply/witness gaps.
The original targetClaims map protects actual pending attack sends, not the entire approach. No overlapping same-target attack intervals were observed in the complete stage projection.
